content.introduction: According to the YouTube video, Bitcoin has been flirting with an all-time high and Ethereum is testing how much cheaper block space it can safely create. The video mentions Bitcoin's retest of $112K, a breakout above $117K, and a weekend rally pushing it to $122K. Ethereum broke $4K after 18 months. Another YouTube video reports Bitcoin surging above $61,500 and Ethereum gaining over 6% in the last 24 hours. The crypto.news site does not provide specific headlines for today but lists various crypto-related topics and top stories from earlier dates.
